title: aftergrid revisit (v0.1): re-test merged Findings against refreshed Snapshot
description: ADR 0009. refresh Snapshot -> rerun executions -> compare Claims within tolerance (insufficient-data below threshold) -> evaluate falsifier Check -> new revision: decision holds / rests on flipped Claim / data no longer supports. Decision log rendered as a board. Operator-reviewed, never automatic. Marketing: 'the analysis that re-checks itself'.

title: Revisit schema in v0 manifest: Claim tolerance, falsifier Check, revisit condition
description: ADR 0009. v0 manifest must carry per-Claim tolerance (abs/rel + minimum-data threshold), the Question's falsifier as a Check reference with expected outcome, and a structured revisit_when on Decision records. check validates presence and shape. Without these fields no v0 Finding can ever be revisited.

title: v0: one Finding end to end
description: Spec: docs/spec/v0-one-finding-end-to-end.md (public mirror: GitHub issue #1). Design: docs/design/v0-design-2026-09-15.md. Glossary: CONTEXT.md. ADRs: docs/adr/0001-0008. Independent review reconciled in docs/design/reconciliation-2026-09-15.md.
design: Build order from spec Further Notes: evidence manifest schema + check on fixtures -> synthetic dataset + DuckDB adapter -> render -> skills in chain order (/write-finding first) -> /setup-aftergrid -> Postgres adapter -> hook -> background intake -> golden Questions. Test seams: (1) Finding directory -> check/render on every PR; (2) adapter contract suite over DuckDB + Postgres on every PR; golden-Question evals nightly.
